title: Quasi-Classical Braverman--Kazhdan Intertwiners via Quiver Varieties
summary: We show that Braverman--Kazhdan normalized intertwiners for $SL_n(\mathbf{C})$ have a quasi-classical incarnation governed by type $A$ quiver varieties. More precisely, for standard parabolic subgroups $P$ and $P'$ with conjugate Levi subgroups, we construct $SL_n\times L^{\mathrm{ab}}$-equivariant isomorphisms $Φ(P,P'):\overline{T^*(SL_n/[P,P])}^{\mathrm{aff}}\rightarrow\overline{T^*(SL_n/[P',P'])}^{\mathrm{aff}}$ between the affinizations of the cotangent bundles of the corresponding Braverman--Kazhdan spaces, and we prove that these isomorphisms satisfy Coxeter relations.
